items.title: ArmSoM Sige6 Allwinner A733 SBC features up to 128GB soldered-on eMMC flash, 16GB LPDDR5
items.summary: ArmSoM Sige6 is yet another SBC powered by the Allwinner A733 octa-core SoC, offered in a credit card form factor with up to 128GB soldered-on eMMC flash and up to 16GB LPDDR5. The single board computer features a microSD card slot and an M.2 M-key PCIe 3.0 x2 slot for storage, Gigabit Ethernet (with optional PoE), WiFi 6, and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity, HDMI 2.0 and MIPI DSI display interfaces, a MIPI CSI camera interface, USB 3.0/2.0 ports, a 3.5mm audio jack, a 40-pin GPIO header, and more. items.title: PoCL 7.2 Released With Official OpenCL 3.0 Conformance On RISC-V & x86_64 CPUs
items.summary: The Portable Computing Language project is out today with PoCL 7.2 as this portable, MIT-licensed OpenCL implementation that runs across various CPU architectures as well as targeting other GPUs/hardware with LLVM back-ends. Notable with PoCL 7.2 is bringing official OpenCL 3.0 conformance on x86_64 and RISC-V processors...
items.title_zh: PoCL 7.2 发布，在 RISC-V 与 x86_64 CPU 上通过 OpenCL 3.0 官方一致性认证
items.summary_zh: Portable Computing Language 项目发布 PoCL 7.2，这是一款基于 MIT 许可证的可移植 OpenCL 实现，可运行于多种 CPU 架构，并通过 LLVM 后端支持 GPU 及硬件。新版本在 x86_64 和 RISC-V 处理器上实现了 OpenCL 3.0 官方一致性认证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: OpenCL 3.0 一致性认证使 RISC-V 在通用 GPU 计算领域获得更完善的软件生态支持。

items.title: Qualcomm introduces Dragonwing Q-2390 and IQ-2390 for consumer and industrial AIoT applications
items.summary: Qualcomm has announced the Qualcomm Dragonwing Q-2390 and IQ-2390 quad-core Cortex-A78/A55 processors for AIoT consumer, commercial and industrial applications. The Dragonwing Q-2390 processor is designed for commercial and consumer devices, notably for applications such as retail and smart home products, as well as smart displays and enterprise edge devices, while the Dragonwing IQ-2390 processor is the SKU from the Dragonwing IQ2 Series designed for industrial automation, machine vision, building management and energy systems. items.summary: YuzukiHD has made another open-source hardware Linux SBC. YuzukiNeko is a Raspberry Pi Pico-sized single board computer powered by a new Allwinner F101 RISC-V SoC. The Allwinner F101 processor features a single 1.008 GHz C907 RISC-V core, 8MB or 16 MB PSRAM, and support for various display interfaces such as MIPI DSI, 24-bit RGB, and LVDS. The YuzukiNeko board itself features the F101 SoC, an SPI NOR flash, a microSD card for storage, a USB-C port, and two 20-pin GPIO headers. items.title: Amlogic A311Y3 Cortex-A78/A55 Edge AI system-on-module delivers up to 8 TOPS

items.title: Radxa Linkr – A USB drive-sized IP KVM with USB-C, Ethernet, and WiFi support
items.summary: Radxa Linkr is a compact, USB flash drive-sized IP KVM that connects to the target through HDMI and USB for video, keyboard, and mouse emulation. The user can control it over USB-C, Ethernet, or WiFi client/access point, even before the OS is booted. The device does not require any specific apps, since all you need is a web browser. The company also highlights support for Tailscale VPN, two-factor authentication, and AI agents such as OpenClaw and Hermes. items.summary: The USB-C Deskradar is an ESP32-C3-based, aviation-themed ADS-B flight tracker that tracks and displays live aircraft positions around your location on a sonar-style circular grid. A 1.28-inch round display and a 3D-printed enclosure provide a real-time view of flights around a configured location. items.title: LLVM Developers Discuss Enabling ClangIR Build By Default
items.summary: ClangIR has been in development for a number of years now as a new intermediate representation for the Clang compiler. ClangIR makes use of MLIR and is higher-level than LLVM IR. With ClangIR able to preserve more C/C++ source semantics, its usage can lead to better diagnostics, code/static analysis, and more performance optimizations compared to everything lowered straight away from AST to LLVM IR. While not enabling its usage by default, LLVM stakeholders are discussing at least now building it by default...

items.title: NVIDIA Posts vGPU Manager & VFIO Variant Driver For Open-Source Nova
items.summary: NVIDIA continues building out more functionality around the open-source, upstream Nova kernel graphics driver within the Linux kernel. Making it out to the mailing list this Saturday is a set of 13 patches for introducing a NVIDIA vGPU manager and VFIO variant driver...
items.title_zh: NVIDIA 为开源 Nova 驱动提交 vGPU Manager 与 VFIO 变体驱动补丁
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 继续完善 Linux 内核中开源 Nova 内核图形驱动功能。本周末在邮件列表中发布了 13 个补丁，引入 NVIDIA vGPU manager 及 VFIO 变体驱动支持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 此次提交意味着开源 Nova 驱动对 vGPU 虚拟化场景的覆盖向前推进，有助于 Linux 生态在云端 GPU 虚拟化场景中获得更完整的上游支持。

items.title: Linux Patches Posted For Initial Enablement Of The Apple A18 Pro + MacBook Neo
items.summary: In addition to Linux developers focused on Apple Silicon being busy enabling functionality for the M3 and newer SoCs under the Linux kernel, there are also developers working on enabling the A18 Pro SoC used by the new, budget-friendly MacBook Neo laptop. Patches were posted this week for initial enablement of the A18 Pro and the MacBook Neo Device Tree... But even with these patches, the Linux support is still severely limited for now...
items.title_zh: Linux 内核收到 Apple A18 Pro 及 MacBook Neo 初步支持补丁
items.summary_zh: 除为 M3 及更新 SoC 完善 Linux 支持外，开发者本周提交了针对 MacBook Neo 所搭载 A18 Pro SoC 及设备树的初步启用补丁，但目前 Linux 支持仍非常有限。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这批补丁标志着 Apple A18 Pro 进入 Linux 适配早期阶段，为后续完善 MacBook Neo 等设备的 Linux 运行体验奠定基础。

items.title: GPIBee (UsbGpib V3) USB-to-GPIB adapter gains Ethernet (PoE), but launches as closed-source hardware
items.summary: Last December, we wrote about XyphroLabs’s UsbGpib open-source hardware, affordable, and portable USB-to-GPIB adapter designed for legacy GPIB/IEEE-488 instruments and offering modern hardware and software. At the time, the UsbGpib V3 was also in the works with Ethernet (PoE) support, and the good news is that it’s now available, but named GPIBee. The less good news is that while V1 and V2 were both open-source hardware products (and still are), the GPIBee has been released as closed-source hardware for reasons we’ll explain below. GPIBee specifications: Microcontroller – Not disclosed. But not the Microchip ATMega32U4 8-bit AVR MCU found in V2 since its USB interface is limited to 12 Mbps Host interfaces USB 2.0 (480 Mbps) Type-C port with support for four modes Full USBTMC (USB Test and Measurement Class) VXI-11 over USB-Ethernet (CDC NCM) linux-gpib native interface Prologix-compatible (++ commands) via CDC UART (virtual COM port) 10/100Mbps Ethernet RJ45 port [...] The post GPIBee (UsbGpib V3) USB-to-GPIB adapter gains Ethernet (PoE), but launches as closed-source hardware appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: Microduck – A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun
items.summary: Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face have unveiled the Microduck, a 25 cm tall biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two motion sensors, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects. This follows the launch of the Reachy Mini desktop robot earlier this year that featured a Raspberry Pi CM4 module or could interface to a computer instead. In some ways, we may think of the Microduck as a Reachy Mini with legs, but the company says both are different products. The Reachy Mini targets human-robot interaction, while the Microduck focuses on motion/action, although it also features a microphone and a speaker for audio interaction. Microduck specifications: SoC – Rockchip RK3566 CPU – Quad-core Cortex-A55 processor @ up to 1.8 GHz GPU – Arm Mali-G52 NPU – 0.8 TOPS AI accelerator VPU 4Kp60 H.265/H.264/VP9 video decoder 1080p60 H.264/H.265 video encoder System Memory – 1GB RAM Storage [...] The post Microduck – A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
